title: Take envy to the feet that wash the heart
summary: The one blessed with complete grace touches the feet of the Holy. Comparison is not argued away; it is washed in sangat, humility, and Naam.
takeaway: Take envy to the holy feet until the heart is washed.
lifeApplication: When envy dirties the heart, move toward the sangat, Bani, or humble service that leaves you cleaner than self-comparison ever could.

source.shortMeaning: Grace brings the heart to the feet of the Holy, where comparison can be washed rather than defended.
source.lifeApplication: When envy rises, move toward sangat, Bani, or humble service that leaves the heart cleaner than it found it.

evidence.coreClaim: Holy company washes the heart more deeply than self-scrubbing or comparison can.
evidence.turn: Envy becomes cleanable when the heart is brought to the feet of the Holy.
evidence.practicalImplication: When envy dirties the heart, move toward the sangat, Bani, or humble service that leaves you cleaner than self-comparison ever could.
